core_obligations: Read off from the definition of localness at a point the diagram of germs that has to be tested (proof lines 8291-8293).
Produce the etale morphism of fibres mapping the lifted point to the given point (proof lines 8294-8296).
Conclude that the two fibre dimensions agree, which is exactly the localness statement (proof lines 8297-8298).
proof_roadmap: The diagram from the definition (proof lines 8291-8293).
difficulty_reason: For each d, the lemma shows that the property of morphisms of germs given by the dimension of the fibre at the point being d is etale local on the source-and-target (statement lines 8279-8288). The proof takes a diagram of germs as in the definition of that localness notion and uses the lemma producing an etale morphism of fibres from the fibre over the image point to the fibre over the point, which carries the lifted point to the given one (proof lines 8291-8296). The dimension of a scheme at a point is invariant under such an etale morphism of fibres, by the local dimension lemma, which gives the required equality and hence the localness (proof lines 8297-8298). The claim is H2: two cited inputs applied to a diagram of germs, with the dependency on the definition of localness at a point delivered as a context span so the reader sees the notion being tested.
